items.title: POLYGON Military - Low Poly 3D Art
items.shortDescription: A low-poly military asset pack containing modular characters, weapons, vehicles, and military base structures. Built with high-performance mobile-ready assets and Universal Render Pipeline (URP) materials.
features: 285 Unique modular environment, weapon, and vehicle prefabs
Mecanim Humanoid rigged armatures with modular weapon sockets
Universal Render Pipeline (URP) & Built-in Render Pipeline presets
Substance-calibrated PBR textures with diffuse and emission maps
Full interactive selection and clean uninstall support

dependencies.name: External Dependency Manager (EDM4U)
dependencies.reason: Required for resolving iOS CocoaPods and Android Gradle native plugins.

dependencies.name: Universal Render Pipeline (URP)
dependencies.reason: Required for PBR military shaders, lighting models, and material rendering.

items.title: Volumetric 3D Lasers
items.shortDescription: Customizable Volumetric 3D Laser System. It will fit perfectly almost in any game, stylized or realistic. All parts and layers of lasers can be tweaked as you like with tons of properties to create unique effects, plus custom particle explosions and distortions.
features: Complete Volumetric 3D Laser system with true 3D depth from any camera angle
Customizable laser layers: vertex offset, noise distortion, tiling, and color grading
Universal Render Pipeline (URP) and Built-in Render Pipeline dual compatibility
Dynamic start and end point impact effects (sparks, explosions, black hole vortex, and flames)
Screen-space normal refraction & distortion particle shaders (SampleSceneColor / GrabPass)
Mobile, Gamma, and Desktop optimized complete effect prefabs
Dual input system support (Legacy Input Manager & New Input System Package)

dependencies.name: Universal Render Pipeline (URP)
dependencies.reason: Required for URP shader passes, SRP Batcher performance, and Scene Color / Depth distortion textures.
